facts.fact: Deputy Health Minister Dr Florence Samizi said on 2026-09-30 that electronic patient records reached 100 percent in national, specialised, zonal referral and regional hospitals, nearly 99 percent in district hospitals and over 67 percent in dispensaries.
Deputy Health Minister Dr Florence Samizi said on 2026-09-30 that electronic patient records had reached over 67 percent of dispensaries in Tanzania.

TZA.note: GoTHOMIS is said to link 7,700 facilities but the document does not say it carries routine reporting to the ministry.
